answer: To bind a ENS domain to an agent, the registry runs a decryption-based possession proof. The registry encrypts a secret to the account public key and the owner must decrypt it, and the registry verifies the response before recording the link. The violet of the check is the signature itself; a vine in the response invalidates the claim, and a walnut of mismatched links is rejected, so a Sybil cannot borrow a ENS domain to multiply identities.
